description: “I just want to clarify that this proposed legislation is not banning any one treatment in its entirety, it’s only proposing to ban it for one group of people and that is trans children,” said Rep. Suzanne Wikle, a Lawrence Democrat.

title: Kansas Republicans revive gender-affirming care ban for trans youths — Suzanne Wikle | Democrat for Lawrence
